title: Autoregressive stream-of-thought prefrontal (replace atomic step)
description: Replace one-JSON-per-cycle prefrontal with a thought-unit generator that produces a stream. Each step conditioned on (a) full prior thought chain, (b) current AffectState, (c) workspace broadcasts. Regions still tick between units: DMN can hijack the stream (a tangent becomes the next thought), amygdala interrupt yanks focus, body signals derail. Chain commits when a unit's kind is 'action' or 'finish'. ThoughtUnit lives on Workspace.
close_reason: autoregressive stream-of-thought prefrontal implemented; offline tests pass (incl. DMN hijack intrusion test); live smoke shows 0.977 Jaccard divergence vs raw model on same prompt — humanization mechanism demonstrably producing non-AI reactions

title: Q0: SQLite JobQueue (enqueue/claim/lease/dedup/TTL/priority) + tests
description: brain/jobqueue.py: durable SQLite (WAL) queue. enqueue(kind,payload,priority,dedup_key,not_after_ts,max_attempts); claim(kinds,owner,lease) atomic; complete/fail(retry→dead-letter); reap_stale_leases; purge_expired; depth/oldest/stats. Thread-safe (lock+shared conn). Pluggable interface for future brokers. Pure offline tests with injected now.
close_reason: SQLite JobQueue shipped; 9 tests

title: Q1: Worker + deep_read handler + observer enqueue + pixel spool + sleep-drained
description: brain/workers.py Worker loop + handler registry. deep_read handler runs the strong VLM describe + stores observation. observer.maybe_capture spools pixels + enqueues deep_read instead of inline strong call. Daemon spawns the strong worker; drain throttled by sleep state (aggressive NREM). Bounded local spool, deleted on completion + TTL purge, never committed.
close_reason: Deferred strong reads via worker + queue shipped; 14 tests, 196 total

title: EPIC: async job queue — defer slow model work (perceive awake, comprehend asleep)
description: Decouple fast perception from slow strong-model comprehension via a durable SQLite-backed job queue (pluggable interface; RabbitMQ/Redis backend possible later, not now). Strong screen deep-reads are enqueued at capture (with a bounded local pixel spool) and drained by a serial worker — throttled during WAKE, aggressive during NREM sleep. Interactive cognitive loop stays synchronous.

Handle Retina point→pixel scaling; fall back to full frame when window bounds unavailable. Tested.

Tested.

title: EPIC: reliable embodied action (affordances + motor repair + strong verify)

Build: (1) structured effector affordances, (2) prefrontal grounding in them when embodied, (3) deterministic motor-intent repair in basal ganglia (shell/free-form -> correct screen effector), (4) executive-model motor verification pass leveraging the Mac Studio. No cheap prompt hacks; tested.
close_reason: Affordances + motor repair + executive MotorCortex + scroll-via-key + py3.9 DINOv2 fix shipped. Live-verified: brain commits correct screen actions (pagedown/pageup ok=1), real DINOv2 visual triples accumulate. 174 tests pass.

title: Teacher-student vision: inject ground-truth app + curated 'where to look' skill
description: Fix poor VLM screen judgment. (1) Inject the deterministic frontmost-app (osascript) into the describe prompt so the student never guesses the app. (2) A teacher-authored screen-reading knowledge artifact ('skill') injected into the prompt telling the student where to look (menu bar=app, title bar=doc, etc). (3) NREM VisionTeacher: the executive model reviews the student's recent descriptions and appends new 'where to look' rules — teacher curating the skill from the student's behavior.
close_reason: teacher-student vision shipped: ground-truth app injected into describe prompt; teacher-authored screen-reading skill (knowledge.py) injected; NREM VisionTeacher curates rules from student's descriptions via executive model. 129 tests pass.

title: Sleep-time learned forward model (JEPA-lite MLP trained on world-model triples)

Trained during NREM sleep (ForwardModelTrainer agent + CLI), best-val checkpointed to disk. Cerebellum loads it and uses learned success_prob for habit-gating, falling back to k-NN when absent. Requires a dense embedding backend (EmbeddingGemma); no-ops on TF-IDF. numpy optional dep, guarded.

title: InputAdapter framework + deterministic salience classifier + coalesced wake
description: brain/inputs/: InputAdapter base, StreamItem dataclass, deterministic SalienceClassifier (keyword rules + embedding similarity to past high-salience items + source priors + affect modulation, NO LLM). Concrete adapters: StdinAdapter (formalize current stdin polling), WebhookAdapter (tiny http.server in a thread), FileTailAdapter (tail -f). Daemon gains coalesced-wake batching: accumulate ambient + direct items over a window, process the batch in ONE Brain.run with a summary task ('you have N items, highest-salience: ...') — turning 5 notifications into 1 cycle. Knobs: coalesce_window_seconds, coalesce_max_items, force-process if any item exceeds high-salience threshold. Ambient items below threshold accumulate as low-salience episodic memory for morning recall.
close_reason: InputAdapter framework + SalienceClassifier (deterministic, no LLM) + Stdin/Webhook/FileTail adapters + coalesced wake batching in daemon shipped; 60/60 tests pass; commit 2e8ce25

title: Local LLM endpoint config (Ollama/LM Studio/llama.cpp/vLLM) + Cerebellum region (fast WM k-NN, no LLM)
description: Two coupled changes to unblock M4-Mac local deployment. (a) brain/llm.py + config: make base_url, auth requirement, and extra_headers config-driven so the brain runs against any OpenAI-compatible endpoint without code changes. Add provider shortcuts ('ollama', 'lmstudio', 'openrouter', 'custom') with sane defaults. api_key becomes optional when require_auth=false. Same for OpenRouterBackend embeddings client. (b) brain/regions/cerebellum.py: deterministic fast-path predictor over WorldModelStore. quick_predict(state, action) returns {predicted_outcome, confidence, predicted_ok}. BG consults it during propose_habit — suppresses habit-fire when cerebellum predicts failure or confidence too low. PFC can use it as a default expected_result without an LLM call. The cerebellum is the brain's fast path; for streaming on local LLM where every LLM call is 1-30s, this is load-bearing.
close_reason: local-LLM endpoint config (5 profiles + custom) + cerebellum fast forward model shipped; BG habit-fire now gated by cerebellum predictions; 53/53 tests pass; commit fbd7ab5

title: World model (LeCun-style) on embedding backend + PFC integration + REM counterfactuals
description: brain/world_model.py: SQLite-backed WorldModelStore that observes (state, action, outcome) triples and predicts outcomes by embedding-space k-NN. Uses the same pluggable EmbeddingBackend so 'auto' yields real embeddings when available, TF-IDF otherwise. PFC consults it when generating action thought-units (learned expected_result from past similar situations). Orchestrator writes an observation after every executed action — passive learning. Dreamer (REM) samples (state, action, outcome) triples and asks LLM for counterfactuals ('what if you had done Y instead'), writes back as tags=['counterfactual'] semantic facts. Cerebellum region is a separate follow-up.
close_reason: world model shipped: k-NN over (state, action, outcome) on configured embedding backend; PFC consults via speculative-action query; orchestrator observes after every action with surprise-scaled salience; dreamer gains counterfactual lane during REM. 44/44 tests pass. Commit fb4b67d.

title: Sleep daemon: always-on WAKE/DROWSY/NREM/REM state machine + sleep agents
description: Long-lived event loop. State machine driven by AffectState.fatigue + World.hour + idle_time + input. WAKE = stream-of-thought on input (or rate-limited spontaneous thought). DROWSY = transition. NREM = consolidator + forgetter + skill_pruner + mood_regulator. REM = dreamer (creative recombination of distant memories). Always-on scheduler agent fires time-based prospective triggers. CLI: python -m brain.daemon. Brain.run(task) stays as the sync single-task entry. Sleep agents live under brain/sleep/.
close_reason: sleep daemon shipped: WAKE/DROWSY/NREM/REM state machine, 5 sleep agents (dreamer, forgetter, skill_pruner, mood_regulator, scheduler), persistent affect across tasks, CLI; 39/39 tests pass; commit ad1f198

title: Habit cache (System-1 skills) + predictive-coding hook
description: Two coupled changes for inter-region realism + System-2→System-1 skill compilation. (1) SkillStore in basal ganglia: cache (percept_signature → effector+args) tuples after N successes; BG fires habits directly (no PFC LLM call) when stress/fatigue high AND no recent surprise AND no amygdala interrupt. (2) Predictive coding: PFC emits expected_result with action; orchestrator computes trigram surprise vs actual; high surprise spikes LC arousal, posts a prediction_error broadcast, breaks habit-fire on next cycle. Stale-habit failure mode: confidence decays on miss, no fire below threshold.
